set_cfg_params_from_state: override encoder config parameters from a checkpoint state dict into an OmegaConf DictConfig
get_encoder_params_state_from_cfg: extract encoder parameters from a DictConfig to save in a model checkpoint
set_seed: set random seeds for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch including CUDA for reproducibility
setup_cfg_gpu: configure CUDA GPU and distributed training parameters from an OmegaConf config object
setup_logger: initialize a Python logger with INFO level and a formatted console stream handler
